verdict.rationale: Carta is an equity management platform, so explaining equity to employees is a fair axis. However, the evidence pack contains only developer-facing API and MCP documentation. That includes a tax-implication calculation API, dilution percentage formulas for the cap table endpoint, and natural-language cap table queries aimed at company and fund users. Nothing shows an employee-facing, plain-language explanation of tax treatment, exercise windows or dilution, and these raw calculation endpoints deliver 'just numbers', which is what the story asks to go beyond.
